transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Monday, November 23. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. Ganga water treaty: Bangladesh looks to India to initiate renewal talks before expiry. 1996 Agreement Expires On Dec 12 Meta AI chief warns: Superintelligence is coming, danger depends on humans. Alexandr Wang has underscored a pivotal year for humanity as we navigate the realms of superintelligence and artificial intelligence. He pointed out the groundbreaking developments in AI, particularly the evidence surrounding the Riemann Hypothesis. As AI evolves, concerns about maintaining human oversight grow, emphasizing the need for deliberate and responsible AI progression. Wang stresses that establishing safety and alignment measures is paramount for our technological future. Kolkata teen witness in mom's murder case found hanging after dad's bail. Sayani Shikari, a key witness in her mother's murder case, was found hanging at her grandparents' house. Her father, Samir Shikari, had been arrested three years prior but was recently released on bail. Concerns arose as he allegedly attempted to contact Sayani after his release, prompting her family to change her mobile number. On Saturday afternoon, she was alone when her family found her deceased later in the evening. Gold falls to rupees 1.21 lakh, silver plunges 16.2 percent ; analysts warn of further losses. On the Multi Commodity Exchange (MCX), December gold futures shed rupees 14,927, or 11 percent , over the past week, settling at rupees 1,21,778 per 10 grams. The contract touched a low not seen in more than a year. Gold was last traded at a comparable level on October 30, 2025, when its price stood at rupees 1,21,508 per 10 grams 'Every single person knew': AB de Villiers backs Khawaja over Sandpapergate claims. De Villiers, who played in the Cape Town Test and scored 64 in the first innings and 63 in the second, has now spoken about the Sandpapergate controversy and the recent claims made by former Australia players Usman Khawaja and Cameron Bancroft. Delhi wakes up to 'poor' air, AQI at 249. Delhi's air quality remains poor, with several monitoring stations recording alarming AQI levels and significant pollution concerns. Punjabi Bagh reported the highest AQI at 282, categorizing it as poorly polluted. The India Meteorological Department has predicted clear skies and the possibility of mist later this week. The Commission for Air Quality Management is assessing the pollution control measures of Delhi and neighboring states. Two Carneys, a fake Donald Trump: Canada PM turns press gallery dinner into a roast. Canadian prime minister Mark Carney brought out a Donald Trump impersonator during a press event. Howler in the field! Gill furious as Akash Deep makes a mess of easy run-out chance. The incident took place in the 74th over, shortly after lunch, when Washington Sundar was bowling. 'Rehire Jensen': Trump backs ex Nvidia CEO's return amid fresh China spy agency claims. US president Donald Trump has once again voiced support for Jensen Huang's possible return as Nvidia's chief executive, saying he hoped the company's board would "rehire" him. 'Why remove mata Sita's name?' Congress slams BJP over 'Jai Shri Ram' remark. Congress leader Ajay Rai on Sunday criticised Uttar Pradesh deputy chief minister Keshav Prasad Maurya over his remarks on the slogans 'Jai Shri Ram' and 'Radhe Radhe', accusing the BJP leader of having a "perverted mindset" for dropping the name of Goddess Sita from the traditional greeting. Doctor quits corporate hospital over admission targets, sparks debate on ethics. Dr. Mahesh Khanna revealed his unsettling encounter with corporate medicine, where he faced undue pressure to admit a patient. This alarming demand, driven solely by profit motives, pushed him to act against his ethics. In a bid to advocate for patient welfare, he discharged a man suffering from acute diarrhoea rather than hospitalize him.

transcript.text: Moving to business, the economy and the markets. South Korea Says Market Measures Will Ease Investor Jitters. South Korea's finance minister said the government's latest market-stabilization measures should help restore investor confidence, even as the benchmark Kospi slumped another 5 percent on Monday following last week's selloff. Oil prices fall amid equity selloff though Iran war attacks limit losses. Brent crude futures fell 28 cents, or 0.30 percent , to $92.29 a barrel by 0216 GMT while US West Texas Intermediate futures fell 15 cents, or 0.18 percent , to $83.26 a barrel Tata Steel share price in focus on announcement to acquire 26.38 percent stake in APL Apollo Tubes for rupees 15,511 crore. Tata Steel plans to buy a 26.38 percent stake in APL Apollo Tubes for about rupees 15,511 crore and make an open offer for another 26 percent . It will also transfer its tubes and pipes business and sell Tata Steel Colors to APL Apollo in deals worth up to rupees 28,000 crore combined. Choice Broking's Sachin Gupta is bullish on JSW Cement and 2 other stocks. Phoenix Mills stock is comfortably positioned above its key moving averages and Ichimoku cloud, reflecting a strong positive price structure. Indian shares set to open higher on foreign inflows as AI selloff persists. GIFT Nifty futures were at 25,912 points, as of 7:58 a.m. IST, indicating a positive start for the benchmark Nifty 50 index, which closed at 25,800.6 on Friday. Stock Market LIVE: GIFT Nifty jumps 160 pts; Kospi down 4 percent ; Brent below $90. Sensex Today Stock Market LIVE Updates Monday: The GIFT Nifty indicated a gap-up open for the Nifty50 index. Asian markets extended losses amid a sell-off in technology stocks Gold Rebounds as Tech Rout Spurs Shift to Havens, Treasury Rally. Gold rebounded from its biggest weekly decline in eight months as a technology-stock rout pushed traders to seek haven assets, driving down US Treasury yields and the dollar. Stocks to watch: Tata Steel, Waaree, Adani Energy, Maruti, IndusInd Bank. Several stocks are likely to remain in focus on Monday following key corporate announcements, major deal approvals, fresh order wins, regulatory updates and business expansion plans. Chief Executive Henry Fernandez conveyed a willingness to consider alternatives to a two-step downgrade of Indonesia's stock-market status in recent direct talks with President Prabowo Subianto, according to people with knowledge of the discussion. 26,000 next milestone for Nifty; Fortis among 3 stock ideas: Osho Krishan. On the levels front, the psychological 26,000 mark now emerges as the immediate milestone, followed by the previous lifetime high of 26,373. Current rally in large-caps a bear market one: veteran investor Shankar Sharma. Sharma calls the recent market rally a countertrend move, remains bullish on small-caps and says foreign buying reflects tactical allocation shifts, not renewed faith in India. FPI, crude oil, global trends to to steer markets in holiday-shortened week. Stock market movement would depend on trading activity of foreign investors, crude oil prices and global trends in a holiday-shortened week ahead, analysts said. Equity markets would remain closed on Tuesday for "Prakash Gurpurb Sri Guru Nanak Dev". "The holiday-shortened week will be influenced by global economic releases, FPI flows and movements in crude oil and the rupee. Domestically, the HSBC Flash India PMI for November, scheduled for Monday, November 23, will provide insights into private-sector activity," Ajit Mishra, SVP -- Research, Religare Broking, said. Top stocks to watch today: Tata Steel, APL Apollo Tubes, Maruti Suzuki, RVNL, Waaree Energies and 17 others in focus. Indian equities climbed to nine-month highs last week despite a wider Asian selloff, as foreign investment flowed into the market. Key corporate updates include Tata Steel's proposed asset sales, large renewable-energy and infrastructure deals, and new orders for several listed companies. InvIT IPO rush gathers pace, 4-5 trusts likely to go public by Mar 2027. Four to five privately placed Infrastructure Investment Trusts (InvITs) are expected to tap the public markets by March 2027 to raise a combined rupees 17,000 crore, as infrastructure developers increasingly turn to this route to mobilise long-term capital and monetise operational assets, investment bankers said. InvITs have already mobilised around rupees 88,000 crore through equity issuances during FY23-FY25, indicating growing investor appetite for infrastructure-backed investment opportunities, according to the Bharat InvITs Association. Among the proposed public offerings, Brookfield-backed Altius Telecom Infrastructure Trust has filed for a potential rupees 6,000-crore IPO as it seeks to convert from a privately placed to a publicly offered InvIT. Investcorp-backed NDR InvIT Trust is also planning to transition into a public InvIT through an issue of up to rupees 750 crore, while KKR and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan (OTPP)-sponsored Vertis Infrastructure Trust is also exploring an IPO. China State Funds Ramp Up ETF Buying to Record as Rout Deepens. China's state-backed funds poured a record amount of money into the market on Friday in another forceful attempt to stem a deepening selloff. Mahindra Finance looks to strike gold in lending. Mahindra and Mahindra Financial Services is exploring acquisitions of gold finance companies to diversify its revenue streams. Treasury Futures Fall as Rising Stock Futures Damp Haven Demand. US Treasury futures declined as demand for havens waned on signs that the recent selloff in equities may be drawing some buyers back. EV two wheeler makers expand dealership networks. Ather Energy, Ola Electric, River Mobility, Oben Electric, and Ultraviolette are expanding their retail footprint as they look to compete more directly with established two-wheeler manufacturers. Oyo eyes January-March IPO. In an October filing, Oravel had cut its proposed IPO size by nearly half to rupees 3,350 crore, amid a recalibration of its fundraising plans. But the size of the increase is anyone's guess. Alice contacted Chinese spies during Nvidia CEO affair. Indian IT firms reported better Q2 growth, but weak deal bookings, selective client spending and slow revenue conversion continue to cloud the sector's recovery. transcript.title: Money, tax and personal finance
transcript.text: Now to your money — taxes, savings and personal finance. Outstanding education loans hit rupees 2.5 trillion in 2026: Why more borrowers over 30 are taking loans. Higher-ticket borrowing, often by those aged above 30, as well as stronger loan origination at non-banking lenders, have led to education loan balances grow threefold since 2019, shows a report by TransUnion CIBIL. Property seller escapes rupees 6.75 lakh cash penalty: 5 lessons from ITAT Chennai ruling for property buyers and sellers. ITAT Chennai has cancelled a rupees 6.75 lakh income tax penalty on a property seller who accepted a cash advance. Here is the ruling, the reasonable cause provisions and five important pointers for property buyers and sellers. The American dream turning into a debt trap? Why young Indian graduates in the US are struggling financially. Today's graduating youngsters in America face a tough job environment, high uncertainty around landing one with a decent pay, pay rises that are lower than historical levels, high inflation around most expenses, and higher threat of layoff and change. This has resulted in a higher credit card debt to manage routine expenses, and inability to take on mortgage loans or build assets. Bank holiday today: Are SBI, HDFC branches in Shillong closed for Seng Kut Snem on Monday, 23 November? See RBI calendar. Bank holiday today: SBI, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Axis Bank, Canara Bank and Punjab National Bank branches will be closed on 16 days this month, including regional holidays and weekend offs, as per the RBI calendar. Luxury air travel: Are business class and premium cabins worth the extra cost?. Why are airlines spending so much money on these cabins? The answer lies in the economics. Economy Class is highly competitive, and passengers often compare airlines mainly on ticket prices. Premium cabins allow airlines to differentiate themselves and generate significantly higher revenue from a relatively small number of seats. 8th Pay Commission: Check how rupees 25,000, rupees 35,000 and rupees 50,000 basic salaries could change under proposed fitment factors. The 8th Pay Commission could revise central government salaries based on the approved fitment factor. Check how the existing basic pay of rupees 25,000, rupees 35,000 and rupees 50,000 could change under the 3.61, 3.833 and 4.00 multipliers proposed by employee unions. Worried about your next SIP? Why your existing portfolio needs more attention than your next instalment. When you are investing, it's not just the monthly SIP that is open to market risks. Your accumulated corpus is also exposed to the same market. And the impact on that will be much bigger. It is for this reason why managing the existing portfolio is probably more important than the decision to stop/ continue your SIP. What is Yash Bharti Samman? Akhilesh Yadav vows to reinstate award, double monthly honorarium to rupees 1L if SP wins UP polls. Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav said the Yash Bharti Samman would be reinstated if his party wins Uttar Pradesh's 2027 Assembly election. He also promised to double recipients' monthly honorarium from rupees 50,000 to rupees 1 lakh. SIP on salary day or at month-end? Does your mutual fund investment date affect returns? What Sensex data reveal. Does investing in a mutual fund SIP on salary day or at month-end affect returns? A WhiteOak Capital analysis of Sensex data found that average 10-year SIP returns varied by just 0.06 percentage points across different investment dates. Income tax notice sent to your old address? When can ITAT declare reassessment proceedings invalid for taxpayers. Can the Income Tax Department reopen an assessment without properly serving a notice? ITAT Delhi quashed reassessment proceedings against a retired DTC employee after finding that the mandatory notice was sent to his former office address. FD interest rate versus maturity date: Should you chase higher returns or choose a tenure that suits your financial goals?. Choosing the highest FD interest rate may not always be the smartest move. Investors should weigh maturity dates, liquidity needs, reinvestment risks and premature withdrawal penalties before deciding how long to lock in their savings. Gold slides to lowest level since September 2025, silver crashes nearly 4 percent : What's driving the selloff?. For gold and silver, the immediate direction may depend on whether the current selloff is driven primarily by short-term liquidation or a more sustained reassessment of monetary policy, global growth and commodity demand. Karur Vysya Bank raises one-year MCLR to 9.30 percent from November 22: Here's what changes for borrowers. Karur Vysya Bank will raise MCLR rates by 5 basis points across all five tenures and cut its Base Rate and BPLR by 25 basis points from November 22. The impact on borrowers will depend on their loan benchmark, reset date, tenure and applicable spread. Will a PF withdrawal for buying a house be tax-free after five years of service?. A partial PF withdrawal for eligible housing purposes does not close the account; the remaining balance continues to earn interest. Because the employee has more than five years of service and contributions, the withdrawal is tax-exempt. Senior citizens can earn 8.5 percent on 5-year FDs: These small finance banks offer the highest rates. Senior citizens can earn up to 8.5 percent interest on five-year fixed deposits. Check the nine small finance banks offering competitive FD rates and what to know before investing. Borrowing money to invest in stocks? Charlie Munger's warning explains why a market crash can put your savings at risk. Charlie Munger warned against borrowing money to invest in stocks. A 30 percent market decline can wipe out 45 percent of an investor's original capital when leverage is involved. Here's why margin calls, interest costs and forced selling can put wealth at risk. Gold prices plunge ahead of wedding season. How much can families save when buying bridal jewellery now?. Gold prices have fallen nearly 24 percent from their August 2026 peak, bringing relief to families preparing for weddings. The correction could lower bridal jewellery costs, helping households save on planned gold purchases ahead of the wedding season. 8th Pay Commission salary hike: Why employees want 50 percent DA merged with basic pay before fitment factor calculation. BPMS has asked the 8th Pay Commission to merge 50 percent of existing DA with basic pay and pension before deciding revised pay structures. The proposal could raise the salary base used to calculate the fitment factor but awaits government approval. Cardiac arrest 15 months after buying rupees 1 crore policy, insurance company denies money to widow; here's what happened. A life insurance company denied the death benefit claim to the wife whose husband passed away due to cardiac arrest. The insurer said that the policyholder had not disclosed other life insurance policies with different companies. Retired employees win rupees 33.95 lakh gratuity battle as Supreme Court says pending appeal cannot delay retirement benefits. The Supreme Court has upheld the release of rupees 33.95 lakh in gratuity to two retired DDA employees acquitted in a corruption case, ruling that a pending appeal against their acquittal cannot indefinitely delay retirement benefits. Donald Trump's investment portfolio: Latest stocks disclosure shows move in Home Depot, McDonald, Nvidia, Tesla, Apple. President Donald Trump's sprawling investment portfolio shifted into dividend-producing ETFs and government securities in September, selling blue-chip names like McDonald's Corp., Home Depot Inc., and Comcast Corp. Delhi Police busts pan-India investment fraud worth rupees 67.78 lakh; 7 arrested across 5 states: 5 lessons for investors.
